description.text: Length of Schooling 2.5 years Admission only available in Fall Semester, opening in September The exact opening date is available in Acceptance Letter. Entrance Examination Entrance Examination includes written and oral test, is held in late June. The exact examination date will be declared on May 25. The subjects of the Entrance Examination are listed in the Majors of SISU's Master's and Doctor's Degree Programs for International Students in 2009. Fees (in CNY) Master's Degree: CNY 26,000 /Year Insurance Fee: about CNY 600 /Year. Teaching materials shall be bought by students themselves. Tuition and any other fees are not refundable once they have been paid to SISU. Completion of Program Diploma and Certificate of Master's Degree will be issued to those who have completed the Mater's program with qualified academic standing. Notes 1) The financial support and custody may be student's parents or relatives in Shanghai. 2) Tuition and any other fees are not refundable once they have been paid to SISU. 3) This brochure is available in Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean. In case of any inconsistency, the Chinese version shall prevail. 4) The Office of International Student Affairs of Shanghai International Studies University reserves the right to explain the items of this brochure.

duration.text: The French at Shanghai International Studies University is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 4. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 5. Personal Statement Personal Statement with the applicant's signature, written in Chinese or in English. You can download a template or sample from here. 6.Indexes and abstracts of published theses/dissertation The indexes and abstracts of published theses/dissertation or other materials to prove applicant's research ability. 7.Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 8.Academic transcript of highest education

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2.Applicant should hold Bachelor's degree diploma or equivalent 3.Good Chinese proficiency which meets the requirements of degree courses; 4.Be in good health condition 5.With reliable financial support and custody.
